runtime_control.pause_semantics: explicit user pause never auto-resumes; no new detail request or conversation transaction begins while paused
runtime_control.cancel_semantics: stop at safe boundary; completed per-conversation commits remain authoritative
runtime_control.sleep_semantics: conservative waits use absolute Date.now() deadlines; elapsed OS sleep counts; wake adds normal request jitter
runtime_control.remote_index_cache: IndexedDB; disposable acceleration data; complete snapshots only persisted

ui.launcher: 44px green, right-edge default at 45% viewport height, half-hidden when idle, position persisted
ui.reporting: preflight details folded into local archive card; sync completion inline; copyable detailed reports; no dedicated report modal
ui.selection: single explicit selected conversation-id set; tri-state select-all applies to full filtered result; counts stay left at a fixed offset as Selected N · Current M / Total T when filtered
ui.directory_flow: remote ready -> choose provider archive root -> detect layout; v1 offers explicit local-only upgrade; v2 auto read-only scan/Plan; manual Rescan local available
ui.remote_scope_cache: persistent Remote Index can render immediately; background head validation; changed head/full-expiry falls back to full refresh; Team remains a separate identity/cache
ui.archive_summary: Local N (in projects P / outside projects R) + New / Verify / Synced / Issues; migration state shown separately
ui.header_context: provider only; scope remains in filter controls and archive directory remains in Local archive card
ui.run_settings: network policy and sync-content settings remain visible but are immutable during an active sync; summaries reflect the run-start snapshot
ui.refresh: normal click = fast newest-window validation; Shift+click = force complete refresh
ui.preflight_status_visibility: does not auto-switch to pending; first-stage UNCHANGED / NEW / VERIFY remain directly observable
